assumption: Upon destroying the instance, StopOffer() is called implicitly or mandatorily beforehand in order to avoid orphaned registrations in the Diagnostic Server.
rationale: The destructor is declared as exception-safe and not thread-safe, while Offer/StopOffer control the communication channel of the DM.
